name: language-detector
body: The scan-orchestrator language detector: maps repo source extensions to language ids (including the new js and md) and forwards module directories to the frontends, skipping generated/dependency directories and not double-running the unified JS/TS frontend over a TS repo that also contains JavaScript. Implemented today by auto_detect_languages / has_extension / id_prefix_for / frontend_cmd in src/main.rs; extended with the js id, the md id, and the Python id (py): the available_languages() probe for the pyfrontend artifact, the frontend_cmd arm for the pyfrontend binary, the APG_FRONTEND_PY baked path, the id_prefix_for arm, and the py entries in auto_detect_languages (extensions .py/.pyi) and the help text.
